choice-route.com: 74. The gap: HSTS.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.

Lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
